faqs.q: Sind die Demo-Spiele auf dieser Landingpage kostenlos?

Wir unterstützen Sofortüberweisung, Kreditkarten (Visa/Mastercard), Apple Pay, SEPA Instant sowie ausgewählte Krypto-Assets (BTC, ETH, USDT).

faqs.q: Wie garantiert Aura Royale faires Spiel (RTP)?

testing_attributes.convention: data-testid on every interactive button, input, tab, counter, and game element

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Never create dark neon generic casino UI. Maintain the pristine ivory/alabaster/champagne light luxury aesthetic throughout.
Do not use transparent dropdowns or invisible hover states. Use backdrop-blur with 80%+ opacity and 1px subtle gold borders.
Framer-motion must be used generously for staggered scroll triggers, live numbers, and interactive card/wheel states.
Include both full playable mini games (Roulette and Blackjack) with sound effects (synthesized AudioContext or visual chime alerts), real state handling, score calculation, and fun reset mechanics.
Make sure all content is in eloquent German as requested in the problem statement.
All interactive elements must carry proper data-testid attributes.
